name: Spaceship 0ccbe694 on 3.6.3.6
description: A period-4 spaceship on the trihexagonal (kagome) tiling 3.6.3.6 (touching neighbours), 8 to 9 cells, moving one lattice step every 4 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 8,192 rules from B36/S23 to B3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12/S2,3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. The same object runs unchanged on k3-030, k3-032 and k3-039. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 423 times). Flagged to check before claiming: runs in HighLife (B36/S23) on an Archimedean tiling; contains a perturbed phase of Guttesen's kagome glider g. We found no earlier report, but others may well have seen it, so it is not claimed.
